header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None is present on behalf of the appellant nor any intimation
received. This acquittal appeal was fixed for hearing on 16.01.2023,
however none appeared on behalf of the appellant. Thereafter, the
matter was listed on 08.09.2026 when Mr. Sikandar Ali Kolachi
Advocate held brief on behalf of counsel for the appellant. Subsequently,
body: on 02.10.2026 learned counsel for the appellant stated that he was not in contact with the appellant and the matter was adjourned with notice to the appellant. Despite of that, none has appeared on behalf of the appellant today.
Under these circumstances, it appears that the appellant has lost interest in pursuing this appeal. Therefore, this acquittal appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
